metadata.question: In areas across the northeastern Pacific Ocean, were sea surface temperatures cooler in August 2019 than the average for the same month from 1985-2012?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use NOAA OISST daily SST (primary: NOAA/CDR/OISST/V2_1, fallback: NOAA/CDR/OISST/V2). Region: Northeastern Pacific bounding box lon [-180, -110], lat [0, 60]. Compare August 2019 daily mean vs August climatology mean across 1985–2012.
2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking needed (SST). Use inherent mask to exclude land/invalid pixels. Validate pixel counts after masking.
3. Logic: If collections empty -> C1. If valid pixel counts after masking are 0 -> C2. If any computed mean or delta is null/NaN -> C3. If delta (2019 - climatology) < 0 => A (Yes, cooler), else B (No).
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function getInfoAsync(obj) {
  return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    obj.getInfo((res, err) => {
      if (err) reject(err);
      else resolve(res);
    });
  });
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const region = ee.Geometry.Rectangle({coords: [-180, 0, -110, 60], geodesic: false});
    const aug2019Start = '2019-08-01';
    const aug2019End = '2019-09-01';
    const climStart = '1985-01-01';
    const climEnd = '2013-01-01'; // up to and including 2012
    const datasets = ['NOAA/CDR/OISST/V2_1', 'NOAA/CDR/OISST/V2'];

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallback
    let chosenId = null;
    let colBase = null, col2019 = null, colClim = null;
    let n2019 = 0, nClim = 0;

    for (const ds of datasets) {
      try {
        colBase = ee.ImageCollection(ds).select(['sst']);
        col2019 = colBase.filterDate(aug2019Start, aug2019End);
        colClim = colBase.filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(8, 8, 'month'))
                         .filterDate(climStart, climEnd);
        n2019 = await getInfoAsync(col2019.size());
        nClim = await getInfoAsync(colClim.size());
        if (n2019 > 0 && nClim > 0) { chosenId = ds; break; }
      } catch (e) { /* try next dataset */ }
    }

    if (!chosenId) {
      console.log('No images for one or both periods after fallback.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing: monthly means and valid pixel counts
    const img2019 = col2019.mean();
    const imgClim = colClim.mean();

    const scale = 25000;
    const rp = {reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9};
    const count2019 = await getInfoAsync(img2019.reduceRegion(rp).get('sst'));
    const countClim = await getInfoAsync(imgClim.reduceRegion(rp).get('sst'));

    if (!count2019 || !countClim || count2019 === 0 || countClim === 0) {
      console.log(`Aug 2019 valid pixels: ${count2019 || 0}, Clim valid pixels: ${countClim || 0}`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation: regional means and delta
    const rm = {reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9};
    const mean2019 = await getInfoAsync(img2019.reduceRegion(rm).get('sst'));
    const meanClim = await getInfoAsync(imgClim.reduceRegion(rm).get('sst'));
    const delta = (mean2019 !== null && meanClim !== null) ? (mean2019 - meanClim) : null;

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    const invalid = (mean2019 === null || meanClim === null || delta === null || !isFinite(delta));
    console.log('Region: NE Pacific lon[-180,-110], lat[0,60]');
    console.log(`Dataset: ${chosenId}`);
    console.log(`Aug 2019 images: ${n2019}`);
    console.log(`Aug 1985-2012 Aug images: ${nClim}`);
    console.log(`Valid pixels 2019 mean: ${count2019}`);
    console.log(`Valid pixels clim mean: ${countClim}`);
    console.log(`Mean 2019: ${mean2019}`);
    console.log(`Climatology mean: ${meanClim}`);
    console.log(`Delta (2019 - clim): ${delta}`);

    if (invalid) {
      console.log('C3');
    } else if (delta < 0) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
